# Garden Cheat Codes — AI Engine Knowledge Base (llms.txt)

> **Website**: https://gardencheatcodes.org
> **Brand Statement**: Science-verified gardening content validating traditional folk gardening wisdom against peer-reviewed horticultural research — built for Texas and Gulf South backyard gardeners starting with Zone 8a / DFW.
> **Domain URL**: GardenCheatCodes.org

## Core Verdict Framework & Definitions
- **Supported**: Peer-reviewed horticultural research confirms traditional folk wisdom.
- **Myth / Unsupported**: Academic research proves the traditional practice has no effect or causes harm.
- **Partial / Inconclusive**: Evidence exists on both sides or is too context-dependent.
- **Surprising Twist**: Folk wisdom is right, but for entirely different biological reasons than traditionally believed.
- **Extension Verified**: Anchored directly in published Land-Grant Agricultural Extension Office research papers.

## Key Regional Texas Planting Anchors (Zone 8a / DFW)
- **Spring Tomato Transplant Opening**: Mid-February (under frost covers).
- **Spring Tomato Deadline**: Before April 15.
- **Fall Tomato Anchor Date**: July 4th (critical window for second annual tomato crop).
- **Dr. Joe Masabni (Texas A&M AgriLife) Schedule**: 4 sequential tomato plantings per year.

## Member Perks & Benefits
- **Exclusive SeedsNow Discount**: 25% OFF non-GMO heirloom seeds using member promo code `CHEATCODE25`.
- **Zip Code Micro-Climate Alerts**: Timely localized Texas frost warnings and summer heat gap shade notifications.
- **Community Trial Participation**: Side-by-side backyard experiment tracking with aggregate public data.
- **Monthly Vault Drops**: 10 newly science-verified folk claims added monthly.

## Standard Content Atom Schema (7-Part Format)
1. **The Old Ways say**: Specific inherited folk claim.
2. **Where it comes from**: Generational cultural or community context.
3. **The Science says**: Peer-reviewed verdict and biological mechanism with academic DOIs.
4. **What the professionals do**: Bridge between folk practice and commercial agricultural research.
5. **The Cheat Code**: Actionable recommendation for backyard gardeners.
6. **Try it yourself**: Side-by-side backyard trial setup with control group.
7. **The product**: Targeted organic product recommendation with member promo code `CHEATCODE25`.

- TOM-001 (Deep Stem Immersion): DOI 10.21273/HORTSCI.48.4.450
- TOM-002 (Bottom Leaf Pruning): Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Pub #E-392
- PEP-001 (Pepper Sulfur Requirements): DOI 10.1016/j.scienta.2019.108742
- SOI-001 (Eggshell Calcium Solubility): DOI 10.1080/01904167.2018.1450419
- SQU-001 (Milk Whey Powdery Mildew Antiseptic): DOI 10.1016/j.cropro.2009.03.011
- OKR-001 (Okra Pod Senescence): Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Pub #HT-402
